assumptions.assumption: The model assumes that the XmlFile class is the central class representing an XML file, and all other classes are its components.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Requirement R2: 'An attribute node' is not represented in the model.
Requirement R3: 'an XML file comprises Text elements' is not represented in the model.
Requirement R5: 'an XML file comprises Root elements' is not represented in the model.
Requirement R6: 'A Node of an XML file may have one parent which is an Element of the XML file' is not represented in the model.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Add a relationship from Node to Element with cardinality 0..1..1.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Requirement R7: 'An Element of an XML file can have many children Nodes' is partially represented. The current model shows an association but not the multiplicity.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Ensure the association from Element to Node has the correct multiplicity (1..*..1).

verifier_problems_last.issue: Requirement R4: 'an XML file comprises Element' is not represented in the use case or actor.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Add a use case or actor related to the presence of Element in the XML file.
